rationale: CN 7318 is listed in Annex II, so only direct emissions are taken into account under the current CBAM rules.
allowed_use: May be retained as supporting energy and operational evidence.
prohibited_use: Do not add corporate Scope 2 electricity emissions to CBAM direct embedded emissions for the synthetic CN 7318 product.

reference_locator: Articles 3 to 6 and Annex II, direct emissions within production-process system boundaries
rationale: Fuel combusted in a heat-treatment process inside the product production boundary may support direct embedded-emissions preparation.
allowed_use: May be used as candidate direct-emissions activity evidence after conversion, allocation, and verification requirements are satisfied.
prohibited_use: Do not assign the whole factory gas bill to EU-exported fasteners without a verified heating value, production-boundary evidence, and an allocation method.
required_data: verified heating value; reporting period; product allocation method; production-process evidence

rationale: Company-vehicle fuel is outside the synthetic fastener production-process boundary.
allowed_use: May remain in the corporate GHG inventory.
prohibited_use: Do not include company-vehicle Scope 1 emissions as CBAM product-process direct emissions.

reference_locator: Annex II precursor data requirements for materials obtained from another installation
rationale: Purchased steel may be a relevant precursor, but the raw record does not prove its exact CN classification or provide the required supplier-installation and embedded-emissions information.
allowed_use: May be used to identify a potential precursor-data request.
prohibited_use: Do not treat a generic corporate Scope 3 estimate or purchase quantity as verified CBAM precursor embedded-emissions data.
required_data: precursor CN code; country of origin; producing installation; production route; specific embedded emissions; reporting period; quantity used

reference_locator: Articles 4 and 6, functional unit, activity level, and attribution to goods
rationale: Finished-goods output may support the product quantity or denominator needed to express embedded emissions per tonne.
allowed_use: May support activity-level and allocation calculations for the synthetic scenario.
prohibited_use: Do not treat production output as negative emissions or as a formal CN 7318 customs determination.
required_data: confirmed CN classification; confirmed product quantity; reporting period; allocation relationship
